title: Siman 203
section: His Journey and Residence in Uman

segments.he: (יט) י' איר ספר בכאן בבית רבי נחמן נתן שאצל השיבה שופטינו בא על דעתו רבי נחמן נתן, הינו שיעשה בשבילו לתקנו:
segments.en: (19.) The 10th of Iyar — he told [something] here in the home of Rabbi Nachman-Nussun: that while reciting [the morning prayer beginning] "Restore our judges as of old" (Hashiva shoftaynu), the thought of Rabbi Nachman-Nussun came to his mind — meaning that he thought to do something for him to rectify him.
